product_metadata.title: IMAX Towel/Wine Rack, Brown
features: Multipurpose Towel Rack: display rack is multi-use asset to any home; Suitable to hang towels, wine bottles, magazines, sporting equipment, fashion accessories, outer wear, wine, cookware or mugs; Can also be used as a wrapping center

High Quality Storage Rack: towel rail made from sturdy metal; Lightweight rack is often bought as a part of bathroom furniture ensemble; Offers impressive resistance against corrosion; Suitable for long term use

Space Organizer Towel Rack: wine rack is especially crafted for smaller living spaces; Different sizes of compartments solve the purpose of organizing small and big towel rolls with ease; Compact in size display rack can be wall mounted for better space utilization

Versatile Storage Holder: wall mounted towel rail comes in dark brown color, matches every decor style; Display rack is an Ideal housewarming gift; Decoration rack can add more substance to your wine storage setup

Easy installation: storage rack is easy to fix; Metal rack can be mounted to the wall with two top screws and anchors for a strong fitting; Smart space organizing solution includes 7 holdings offering more storage space
description: A functional space organizer offering good storage IMAX 9748 towel/wine rack is meant to liven up your home decor. Decoration rack is used to hang towels, wine bottles, magazines, sporting equipment, fashion accessories, outer wear, wine, cookware and mugs or use it as a wrapping center. An ideal solution to smarter bathroom or living room, this display rack can also be incorporated in hotels at reception areas for displaying magazines or newspapers. Wall mounting feature means saving precious floor or countertop space. Use of solid metal adds strength to the display rack.
